= "14 positive and 10 unsafe controls; one queued Tcl entry and pin, one parent epoch and one run cleanup. Opaque Tcl/run root contents, live owner/token and external drain/settlement are premises; not a shared-VM evaluator/ABI/weak-memory proof."
= "Conditional pin/delete lifetime, park/epoch, run return/cleanup/count and payload equations; selective operation laws, no complete QNT trace/source simulation."
= "Live token anchor, owner-thread callback entry pin before data_rc, deleteProc close without self-wait, preserve trace/replacement behavior and separate Command versus ClientData lifetime."
= "Every parent raw borrower stops, full map includes continuation/denv/native activation, context preparation and same-owner reload; no Tcl event pumping or duplicate call to avoid wait cycle."

= "Transfer registered startup/worker thunk origin before worker publication/read/synchronization, then root before marker; cover ___call rethrow and known marker failure with post-END_TRY canonical cleanup; source data_scmobj alone is not root coverage."
= "One custodian records marker initialized/cleared/count drop and root/status transfer; preserve setjmp-defined state, original error, frame/catcher and unknown-progress custody."
= "Actual Tcl version/installed match, trace reentry, queued/raw dispatch and reentrant CreateCommand installation/discard paths; no drain inferred from zero active entries."
= "Concrete lock/lifetime/read-from, release/acquire park/reload, effect-qualified marker stores and scanner/root registry order; no native C refinement receipt."
= "First future source slice spans ___run plus activation-root/scanner/marker contracts; not kill-only repair or unconsumed API. Scheme SFUN generator and Tcl adapter have explicit later gates."

= "Mapped parent source lease exists before foreign export; child acceptance covers roots before source release; park complete parent on close without keeping raw borrower active or violating synchronous C ABI."
= "Normal/conversion error and ___call/___run rethrow paths need canonical cleanup progress, nested duty, accepted result/error and data-write closure before freeing roots/marker/code."

= "Actual C pin/retire, source-to-child acceptance, close/park, scan/update/reload and reclaim edges; ordinary C object lifetime, setjmp automatic-local rules and lock adapters still require refinement."

= "Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots."
= "TclInvokeStringCommand -> proc(clientData) -> scheme_call_cmd -> data_rc -> tcltk_call -> Scheme apply"
= "Acquire owner-scoped token/entry pin before data_rc, marker or conversion; no callback/GC/layout effect before accepted raw access."
= "Token storage lifetime must already cover first hook. Same-owner Tcl dispatch is selected; arbitrary cross-thread Tcl use and saved raw callbacks are excluded."
= "delete traces and imported command deletion -> deleteProc -> hash/Command cleanup"
= "Close at replacement scheme_delete_cmd first non-reentrant action; return without waiting for pins held by the deleting callback itself. Release payload after pins/results retire."
= "Tcl Command reference counts do not defer extension deleteProc or preserve ClientData. Closing before Tcl traces would change allowed reentry; retain pre-deleteProc trace behavior."
= "alloc_rc + still vector -> Tcl_CreateCommand; name conflict invokes old delete; recreated command may be discarded"
= "Construction transaction must distinguish never installed, installed, displaced and unknown token ownership. Retain tombstones until actual owner/dispatch quiescence."
= "CreateCommand return NULL, reentrant replacement and private/raw dispatch remain open routes; no universal drain receipt derived from pins==0."
= "CFUN state materialization -> Tcl_Eval -> callback -> child registration attempt during GC close"
= "Freeze complete mapped parent locations, stop raw access and preserve native argv/catcher/activation; service only admitted VM wait work, then context seal, reload, same-call retry."
= "W_ALL and service_sync_op are source mechanisms, not complete freeze/map/binding receipts. Do not pump Tcl events under the gate or keep a raw borrow while waiting for reopen."
= "thread binding -> program descriptor module thunk -> ___run -> cleanup on nonzero error"
= "First slice roots the already selected thunk before allocating marker and uses canonical NativeActivation cleanup after END_TRY for every outcome."
= "Input source root authority from program descriptor must be proved, not inferred from the C local thunk parameter."
= "thread data_scmobj -> resize synchronization -> ___run_and_throw_error_on_processor_0 -> ___run -> OP_PROCESSOR_0_THROW_ERROR -> sync service loop"

= "Keep worker source root from thread publication through the pre-___run synchronization loop, root reload, marker allocation and guard cleanup; deliver the original error only after activation retirement is settled."

= "start_processor_execution loads thunk before execute_sync_op_loop; a guard only inside ___run does not cover that interval. Thread data_scmobj alone is not a root-scanner proof. Zero/nonzero processors and source handoff remain separate admission obligations."
= "___call catches then rethrows to ___run outer catcher; inline kill after ___call is skipped"
= "Root/marker ownership state survives setjmp; after catcher restoration one cleanup claimant invalidates marker, drops owned count once, settles root/result backing, then returns original status."
= "Unknown marker decrement cannot be replayed or assumed done. Do not broadly restore arbitrary GVM state or replace language exception/continuation behavior."
= "Pin and close share one control domain, token address is stable independently of payload. Pin winner may finish; close winner returns defined adapter rejection without reading payload."
= "Delete hook never waits for its own active pin."
= "Last native return/result acceptor owns pin retirement; deferred payload release runs outside control lock."
= "Extension payload and Tcl Command storage retire at different points"
= "Payload can retire at closed+zero accepted readers; closed token/tombstone survives already captured or unknown future entry."
= "Zero active pins is not owner dispatch drain or interpreter physical destruction."
= "Registry/owner anchor retains token until the selected native producer inventory and quiescence receipt close."
= "Stop raw writes/reads -> full view freeze -> collector update -> context ready -> reload"
= "Freeze exact location map and continuation/denv, native activation and same invocation; no raw copies live across the moving epoch."
= "Unknown borrower stop refuses freeze and source-ack retirement. A GC-done signal without context-ready/binding/reload is insufficient."
= "Parent retains source until child canonical acceptance; lost ACK queries same activation and keeps overlap."
= "VM-owned activation state records root acceptance, marker creation, cleanup claim and error/return intent. No sole progress flag in a modified nonvolatile setjmp local."
= "Known marker failure still retires source root. Unknown close/decrement retains root and must be settled from actual progress evidence."
= "Exactly one cleanup custodian; marker invalidation precedes owned count decrement and root release."
